name: RC-B10-0146/2025/REV1 – After § 6 – Am 51
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: 6a. Is deeply concerned that global military expenditure continues to rise to new record levels; highlights the fact that an arms race will not create security for European citizens, but instead, in line with the security dilemma, will heighten the risk of violent conflict; calls on the Commission to actively promote new arms control treaties;
